The main takeaway from our work is that
the compositionality of compounds is not a simple linear combination of word meanings and cannot be captured with a single model.
the compositionality of a compound can be predicted with a high accuracy, even when the compounds contain a high number of words.
, while DSMs perform reasonably well for fully compositional compounds, they struggle with the more challenging cases, where the degree of compositionality is not so clear-cut.
